name: explore-forge-jira-custom-api
description: Exploration Forge App for a Jira custom REST API

scripts.test:api:bootstrap:webtrigger: set -a && . apps/webtrigger/.env && set +a && uv run integration/webtrigger/generate-jwt.py
scripts.test:api:api-route: hurl --version >/dev/null || (echo 'Error: Hurl is not installed. Visit https://hurl.dev to install.' && exit 1); test -f integration/api-route/.oauth.hurl || (echo 'Error: integration/api-route/.oauth.hurl is missing. Run npm run test:api:bootstrap:api-route first.' && exit 1); hurl --test --variables-file integration/api-route/.env.hurl --variables-file integration/api-route/.oauth.hurl integration/api-route/workitem.hurl
scripts.test:api:webtrigger: hurl --version >/dev/null || (echo 'Error: Hurl is not installed. Visit https://hurl.dev to install.' && exit 1); test -f integration/webtrigger/.jwt.hurl || (echo 'Error: integration/webtrigger/.jwt.hurl is missing. Run npm run test:api:bootstrap:webtrigger first.' && exit 1); uv run integration/webtrigger/validate-env.py && hurl --test --variables-file integration/webtrigger/.env.hurl --variables-file integration/webtrigger/.jwt.hurl integration/webtrigger/workitem.hurl
scripts.test:api: npm run test:api:api-route && npm run test:api:webtrigger
